checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-skills.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" skills --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Inspect and validate the skills/ tree' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'link' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'find' "$tmp/help"; "$tmp/ao" skills link --help >"$tmp/linkhelp"; grep -Fq 'git pull && ao skills link' "$tmp/linkhelp"; grep -Fq '~/.codex/skills' "$tmp/linkhelp"; ( cd cli && "$tmp/ao" skills list --json >"$tmp/list" ); grep -Fq '"hexagonal_role"' "$tmp/list"; ( cd cli && "$tmp/ao" skills graph --format mermaid >"$tmp/graph" ); grep -Fq 'graph LR' "$tmp/graph"

aliases.reason: The skills family declares no command aliases.

tracker_selection.reason: The skills family does not select a repository issue tracker.
